spots.name: Greenmount / Rainbow Bay
spots.result:
DECISION: MARGINAL
QUALITY: 4/10
CONFIDENCE: HIGH

CONDITIONS
Wind: 10.7 knots, 357° (North). This is an onshore to cross-onshore wind for Greenmount/Rainbow Bay, creating chop and disorganising the wave face.
Swell: 1.08 m, 6.05 s, 83° (East-North-East). The swell direction is direct and favourable, but the short period indicates less organised and powerful waves.
Wave height: 1.54 m reported, indicating the overall sea state, not the breaking wave-face height.

ASSESSMENT
The direct swell from 83° is well-aligned for Greenmount/Rainbow Bay. However, the 10.7-knot northerly wind is onshore/cross-onshore, creating chop, and the short 6.05-second swell period will result in less organised waves.

BOARD
A funboard or hybrid would be suitable for navigating the choppy, less powerful conditions.

BEST WINDOW
A reliable time window cannot be determined from the available data.

BOTTOM LINE
Conditions are surfable for a keen surfer, but quality will be significantly limited by the onshore wind chop and short period swell.
